entries.zh: 至高派旨在保证国家创始物种的统治地位。它们推行利于本族的政策，而罔顾其他物种的利益。\n\n§L排外主义和军国主义思潮§!
entries.en: Supremacist Factions wish for their Empire's founding species to dominate. They push for policies that benefit their own species and disadvantage others.\n\n§LXenophobe & Militarist Ethos§!

entries.zh: 传统派希望让帝国的思潮回归到步入星辰大海之前的传统道路上。他们宣扬虔诚苦修，蔑视激进科技和非唯心主义带来的各种社会变革。\n\n§L唯心主义思潮§!
entries.en: Traditionalist Factions desire a return to traditional values that may or may not have existed before the Empire took to the stars. They preach for pious austerity, and scorn the kinds of societal change brought about by radical technology and non-spiritualist values.\n\n§LSpiritualist Ethos§!

entries.zh: 进步派在现有的社会结构中争取公平。他们反对缺乏代表性的政府形式，并重视与其他帝国的平等合作。\n\n§L平等主义思潮§!
entries.en: Progressive Factions campaign for equity within existing social structures. They oppose non-representative forms of government, and value equal collaboration with other Empires.\n\n§LEgalitarian Ethos§!

entries.zh: 帝国主义派渴望稳坐江山，同时统治其他国家。他们乐于与其他国家树敌并将其征服，厌恶依靠其他国家。\n\n§L军国主义和威权主义思潮§!
entries.en: Imperialist Factions crave dominance within our own borders, and over other Empires. They thrive on Rivalries and conquering other Empires, and dislike relying on others.\n\n§LMilitarist & Authoritarian Ethos§!

entries.zh: 孤立主义派倾向于把广泛的星系排除在内部事务之外。他们把与其他帝国的对话保持在最低限度，以避免侵略战争（但并非自废武装）。\n\n§L和平主义和排外主义思潮§!
entries.en: Isolationist Factions prefer when the wider galaxy is kept out of our internal affairs. They campaign to keep discourse with other Empires at a bare minimum, eschewing wars of aggression - but not at the cost of our becoming an easy target.\n\n§LXenophobe & Pacifist Ethos§!

entries.zh: 技术派主张在全国范围采取鼓励科学发展的政策，以利于取得大规模的技术进步。他们厌恶由于政治因素而对某些科研活动颁布禁令，但支持签订科研协议。他们喜欢从技术上超越别的国家，讨厌被其他国家超越。技术派对于人工智能技术的推广运用乐见其成。\n\n§L唯物主义思潮§!
entries.en: Technologist Factions desire an Empire-wide embrace of scientific progress and the fruits of technological advancement. They dislike politically-motivated bans on certain avenues of research, as well as being outpaced by other Empires.\n\n§LMaterialist Ethos§!

entries.zh: 极权派梦想建立一个等级森严的社会，由一位强权人物或一个专制集团统治。\n\n§L威权主义思潮§!
entries.en: Totalitarian Factions dream of a strictly stratified society led by an single authority figure or cabal.\n\n§LAuthoritarian Ethos§!

entries.zh: 亲外派推崇外星生命和文化。他们热衷于人口多元化和与其他物种的互动。他们反对物种层面的奴役和清洗。\n\n§L亲外主义和平等主义思潮§!
entries.en: Xenoist Factions champion alien life and culture. They enjoy diverse populations and interactions with other species. They oppose species-wide Slavery and Purges.\n\n§LXenophile & Egalitarian Ethos§!

entries.zh: 繁荣派希望国家经济能够持续增长并且资源丰收。他们推行自由贸易，不希望爆发影响国内发展的武装冲突。\n\n§L和平主义和亲外主义思潮§!
entries.en: Prosperity Factions desire economic growth and the acquisition of resources. They campaign for the free flow of trade, and they dislike the kinds of armed conflicts that disrupt internal development.\n\n§LPacifist & Xenophile Ethos§!

entries.zh: 民主派在国家领导人选举期间出现，随后在人群中迅速发展，它们致力于把那些受民众欢迎的领袖推上政坛。
entries.en: Democratic Party Factions emerge during Empire Elections and and dissipate shortly thereafter, serving as a means to put certain popular Leaders in the political limelight.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]希望统治者是该物种的成员，任何非[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]担任[Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle]都会惹怒他们。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] want our Ruler to be of their species and will be angered by any non-[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] holding the position of [Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle].

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]希望我们的内阁保持同质性，任何非[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]出现在内阁中将会惹怒他们。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] want our Council to be homogeneous and will be angered by any non-[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] on the council.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]因内阁中存在的非[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]如此之多而怒不可遏。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] are enraged by the number of non-[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] on the council.

entries.zh: 立法允许主动干涉或侵略性干涉土著民，最大效力地利用异种土著文明，如此可以取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Exploiting primitive xeno civilizations to maximum effect by legislating for Active or Aggressive Native Interference will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]并不认为某些人相较于其它人更有价值，他们只是觉得某些人相较于其它人更适合某些工作。宣布§Y奴隶制§!非法会冒犯他们。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] do not believe that some are worth more than others, simply that some are more suited to certain tasks than others. Outlawing §YSlavery§! will displease them.

entries.zh: 确保帝国内异星物种无完整公民权利，这样做可以取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Ensuring that no xeno species within our empire enjoys full citizenship rights will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 任何人胆敢驱使[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]，[Root.GetName]都会倍感愤怒，他们主张奴隶制仅限于异种。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] are angered by the notion of anyone enslaving a [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName], and want slavery to be restricted to Xenos only.

entries.zh: 签署任何§Y移民协议§!都会惹恼[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Signing any §YMigration Treaties§! will displease the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 将帝国核心世界留给[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]和其奴隶独享，此举能够取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Reserving our empire's Core Worlds for the exclusive use of [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] and their slaves will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 对异种帝国宣战会暂时取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Declaring war against one or more xeno Empire(s) will please the [Root.GetName] for a time.

entries.zh: 确保所有[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]人口拥有的基因特质完全相同，此举可以取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Ensuring that all [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] Pops have the exact same genetic traits will please [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 采纳和谐传统，暗示次等物种也应享受平权会惹恼[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Adopting Harmony Traditions alluding to the supposed equality of lesser species will displease the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 采纳任何强调§Y支配§!的传统都会取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Adopting any Traditions emphasizing §YDomination§! will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 消灭任何巨型§Y星神兽§!异种可以暂时取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Putting any of the gargantuan §YLeviathan§! xenos out of their misery will please the [Root.GetName] for a time.

entries.zh: 让[Root.Owner.GetName]§Y加入联邦§!，被外星人榨取利益，此举会使[Root.GetName]不悦。
entries.en: Allowing the [Root.Owner.GetName] to be exploited by alien interests by §Yjoining a Federation§! will displease the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 通过摧毁古老文明的稀有文物，表达对他们的蔑视会取悦[Root.GetName]一段时间。
entries.en: Showing disdain for ancient civilizations by destroying their Minor Artifacts will please the [Root.GetName] for a time.

entries.zh: 陈列低劣文明的稀有文物会使[Root.GetName]不悦一段时间。
entries.en: Showcasing Minor Artifacts of inferior civilizations will displease the [Root.GetName] for a time.

entries.zh: 激进的第一次接触协议
[Root.GetName]要求我们有权利采取一切可能的措施来对抗我们在星际中将会面对的各种未知威胁。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] demand that we have the right to take all necessary measures against unknown threats we may encounter as we travel the stars.

entries.zh: 我们的属国应当为我们服务，他们应对此牢记于心。对他们展现宽容会让[Root.GetName]感到沮丧。
entries.en: Our subjects are here to serve us, and they should always know it. Showing leniency towards them will upset the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 完善和更新机器智能赋予我们的义体将重振我们令人敬畏的遗产，同时也会取悦[root.GetName]。
entries.en: Refining and updating the cybernetics gifted to us by the Machine will reinvigorate our fearsome legacy, and so will please the [root.GetName].

entries.zh: 立法制定微妙干涉或不予干涉[root.owner.GetPreFTLLower]的政策会取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Legislating a policy of Subtle or Non-Interference in [root.owner.GetPreFTLLower] civilizations will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 未将奴役整个物种的行为定为非法，将会极大地惹恼[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Failing to outlaw the wholesale enslavement of an entire species will greatly displease the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 未将净化整个物种的行为定为非法，将会极大地惹恼[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Failing to outlaw the wholesale purging of species will greatly displease the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 屠杀瘫痪方舟舰的船员是[Root.GetName]绝不容忍的野蛮行径。
entries.en: Slaughtering the crews of crippled Arkships is a barbarism the [Root.GetName] will not abide.

entries.zh: 强征受损方舟舰上的人口为我们服役，这将会引起[Root.GetName]的不满。
entries.en: Press-ganging the populations of crippled Arkships into our service will displease the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 禁止对游牧民实施暴行
屠杀瘫痪方舟舰的船员毫无防御意义，还会惹怒[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Putting the crews of disabled Arkships to the sword serves no defensive purpose and will displease the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 强征或处死那些失能方舟舰上的船员是对[Root.GetName]所珍视的自由的背叛。
entries.en: Conscripting or executing the crews of disabled Arkships is a betrayal of the freedoms the [Root.GetName] hold sacred.

entries.zh: 将瘫痪的方舟舰成员处死将会取悦[Root.GetName]，他们将一切异种视为威胁。
entries.en: Putting the crews of disabled Arkships to death will please the [Root.GetName], who see all xenos as a threat.

entries.zh: 确保我们的领土内存在太空城邦以促进文化交流。这可以取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Keeping any Enclave stations within our borders facilitates cultural exchange, which will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 确保我们的驿站附近存在太空城邦以促进文化交流。这可以取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Keeping any Enclave stations near our waystations facilitates cultural exchange, which will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 在帝国内接纳至少§Y4§!个不同的物种可以取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Hosting at least §Y4§! unique species within our Empire will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 无条件接收逃离战争和净化的异族难民的难民政策可以取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Refugee policies allowing indiscriminate acceptance of foreign species fleeing wars and purges will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 与所有接壤邻国保持外交关系可以取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Having diplomatic ties with all of our immediate neighbors will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 将一个外星原始物种提升为智慧物种可以取悦[Root.GetName]一段时间。
entries.en: Uplifting an alien animal species to sapience will please the [Root.GetName] for a time.

entries.zh: 尽可能地通过非侵略的方式，将前超光速外星人文明启蒙，使其见识到太空时代的奇迹，如此行为可以取悦[Root.GetName]一段时间。
entries.en: Enlightening alien pre-FTLs to the wonders of the space age, in as non-invasive a manner as possible, will please the [Root.GetName] for a time.

entries.zh: 不为未开智物种的生存权立法会惹恼[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Failing to legislate for the survival of pre-sapient species will displease the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 非法入侵前超光速星球会让[Root.GetName]不满。
entries.en: Outright invading pre-FTL worlds will displease the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 与其他文明建立通讯联络可以取悦[Root.GetName]一段时间。
entries.en: Establishing communications with other civilizations will please the [Root.GetName] for a time.

entries.zh: 通过陈列一些稀有文物来展示宇宙生命的多样性，会取悦[Root.GetName]一段时间。
entries.en: Celebrating the diversity of life in the universe by showcasing Minor Artifacts will please the [Root.GetName] for a time.

entries.zh: 摧毁稀有文物以拉拢排外主义党徒会使[Root.GetName]不悦一段时间。
entries.en: Destroying Minor Artifacts to rally xenophobes will displease the [Root.GetName] for a time.

entries.zh: 积极的第一次接触协议
将一种和平并且§Y积极§!的方式庄重地纳入我们的第一次接触协议法律中将会带领[Root.GetName]进入星际发现时代。
entries.en: Enshrining a peaceful and §Yproactive§! approach to establishing first contact into our law codes will please the [Root.GetName] in this age of exploration.

entries.zh: 激进的第一次接触协议
在这个探索时代，如果不能立法禁止对探索到的陌生对象的§Y敌对行为§!，将使[Root.GetName]不快。
entries.en: Failure to legislate against §Yaggression§! towards those we meet in our travels will displease the [Root.GetName] in this age of exploration.

entries.zh: 我们的任务是为星系带去开明和繁荣。应当对附属国大力栽培扶植，任何竭泽而渔的行为都会让[Root.GetName]不悦。
entries.en: Our mission should be to bring enlightenment and prosperity to the galaxy. Subjects should be nurtured, and exploiting them will displease the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 照顾我们的附属国并帮助他们的成长将取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Taking care of our subjects and helping them grow will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 本着科学研究和保护的精神建造一座$building_xeno_zoo$，能够取悦[root.GetName]。
entries.en: Building an $building_xeno_zoo$ in the spirit of scientific study and preservation will please the [root.GetName].

entries.zh: 拒绝机器智能强加给我们的义体会减少其他帝国对我们的恐惧，同时也会取悦[root.GetName]。
entries.en: Rejecting the cybernetics inflicted upon us by the Machine will give other empires less cause to fear us, and so will please the [root.GetName].

entries.zh: 未能允许无限制战争将惹恼[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Failing to allow for offensive warfare will displease the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 征服外星人的行星会取悦[Root.GetName]一段时间。
entries.en: Conquering alien planets will please the [Root.GetName] for a time.

entries.zh: 建立一个§Y边境哨站§!来扩张领土可以取悦[Root.GetName]一段时间。
entries.en: Constructing a §YFrontier Outpost§! to expand our territory will please the [Root.GetName] for a time.

entries.zh: 与至少§Y1个帝国§!宣战将会满足[Root.GetName]的心意。
entries.en: Positioning ourselves as the Rival of at least §Y1 Empire§! will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 与至少§Y2个帝国§!宣战将会满足[Root.GetName]的心意。
entries.en: Positioning ourselves as the Rival of at least §Y2 Empires§! will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 与至少§Y3个帝国§!宣战将会满足[Root.GetName]的心意。
entries.en: Positioning ourselves as the Rival of at least §Y3 Empires§! will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 使我们成为一个或多个其他势力的§Y宗主国§!可以取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Installing ourselves as the §YOverlord§! of one or more foreign powers will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 采纳任何强调§Y至高§!的传统都会取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Adopting any Traditions emphasizing §YSupremacy§! will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 消灭一个定居在太空中的§Y星神兽§!可以取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Destroying a space-dwelling §YLeviathan§! will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 身为其他§Y宗主国§!的附属国，将会极大地惹恼[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Being the subject of a foreign §YOverlord§! will greatly displease the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 成为一个戍邦以外的外族§Y宗主§!的附属国将会极大地惹恼[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Being a non-Bulwark subject of a foreign §YOverlord§! will greatly displease the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 发现稀有文物的军事用途会取悦[Root.GetName]一段时间。
entries.en: Finding military applications for your Minor Artifacts will please the [Root.GetName] for a time.

entries.zh: 将稀有文物浪费在琐事上会使[Root.GetName]不悦一段时间。
entries.en: Wasting Minor Artifacts on trivialities will displease the [Root.GetName] for a time.

entries.zh: 强者治，弱者侍。对我们的附属国展现同情心将会使[Root.GetName]不满。
entries.en: The strong rule; the weak serve. Showing compassion towards our subjects will upset the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 我们必须雷厉风行。让附属国明白自己的定位将取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: An iron fist in an iron glove. Making sure that our subjects know their place will please the [Root.GetName].
Being a member of a $military_federation$ will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 建造超过我们帝国的容量的舰队将取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Building our fleet out to our empire's capacity will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 维持远低于我们帝国的容量的舰队将招致[Root.GetName]的不满。
entries.en: Maintaining a fleet well below our empire's capacity will significantly displease the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 禁止§Y无限制战争§!可以取悦[Root.GetName]。
让[Root.Owner.GetAdj]为干预星系事务送命，参与侵略战争会使得[Root.GetName]极度不满。
entries.en: Putting [Root.Owner.GetAdj] lives on the line to meddle in galactic affairs by participating in a war of aggression will greatly displease the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 哪怕为了自卫而举起武器反抗也会使得[Root.GetName]不满一段时间。
entries.en: Taking up arms, even when it becomes necessary to defend ourselves, will displease the [Root.GetName] for a time.

entries.zh: 如果不能撤销与外国势力间不必要的外交联系——比如移民协议，科研协议以及防御条约——这将会遭致[Root.GetName]的厌恶。
entries.en: Failing to eliminate non-essential ties to foreign powers - such as Migration Treaties, Research Agreements, and Defensive Pacts - will displease the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 任何异种迁居本国 —— 无论是难民还是移民条约准许的移民 —— 都将使得[Root.GetName]不满。
entries.en: Any influx of xenos - be they refugees or immigrants under a Migration Treaty - will displease the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 不限制难民涌入我国会惹恼[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Failing to restrict the flow of refugees into our empire - will displease the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 与另一个帝国签署§Y互不侵犯条约§!将会满足[Root.GetName]的心意。
entries.en: A §YNon-Aggression Pact§! with another Empire will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 与其他帝国签署互不侵犯条约十分重要，如果能够与至少§Y2§!个帝国签署，那么我们就能够满足[Root.GetName]的心意。
entries.en: Non-Aggression Pacts with other Empires are considered necessary, and having at least §Y2§! of them will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 与其他帝国签署互不侵犯条约十分重要，如果能够与至少§Y3§!个帝国签署，那么我们就能够满足[Root.GetName]的心意。
entries.en: Non-Aggression Pacts with other Empires are considered necessary, and having at least §Y3§! of them will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 远离星系纷争§Y至少10年§!可以取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Staying out of large-scale galactic conflict for §Y10 years or more§! will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 远离星系纷争§Y至少25年§!可以取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Staying out of large-scale galactic conflict for §Y25 years or more§! will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 远离星系纷争§Y至少50年§!可以取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Staying out of large-scale galactic conflict for §Y50 years or more§! will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 在[Root.Owner.GetAdj]所有拥有§Y5或者更多§!人口的星球上维持至少§Y3§!支防御部队可以取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Maintaining at least §Y3§! Defense Armies on all [Root.Owner.GetAdj] worlds inhabited by §Y5§! or more Pops will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 在每个已殖民恒星系里至少保有§Y1§!座防御站，这样做能取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Maintaining at least §Y1§! Military Station in every colonized system will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 积极的第一次接触协议
[Root.GetName]认为向星空中可能的监听者公开传播我们的信息是不合适的。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] do not consider it appropriate to broadcast information about ourselves across the stars to anyone who may be listening.

entries.zh: 决绝并移除义体强化体、重获自己的生物和政治主权将会取悦[root.GetName]。
entries.en: Rejecting and removing cybernetic augments in order to reclaim our biological and political sovereignty will please the [root.GetName].

entries.zh: 允许用机器人劳工取代有机生命体会使[Root.GetName]不悦。
entries.en: Allowing for the replacement of organic life with robotic workers will displease the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 不将思考机器这类亵渎之物判为非法会惹恼[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Failing to outlaw the profanity that is thinking machines will displease the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 赋予没有灵魂的合成人完整公民权会极大地激怒[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Giving soulless Synthetics full citizen rights will greatly displease the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 让唯心主义成为我国的主流思潮可以取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Having Spiritualist values be reflected in our empire governing ethics will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 虔信者所思皆同，我国至少§Y25%§!的人口成为唯心主义者可以取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Pious minds think alike, and having at least §Y25%§! of our population be some form of Spiritualist will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 唯心主义者在[Root.Owner.GetName]内是少数派会惹恼[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Finding Spiritualist beliefs to be a minority issue in [Root.Owner.GetName] will displease the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 将消费品的消耗量维持在一个较低的水准可以取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Maintaining a low spend on Consumer Goods will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 踏足§Y死寂星球§!，哪怕出于环境改造的目的，都将触怒[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Setting foot on any §YTomb Worlds§!, even for the purposes of terraforming, will upset the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: §Y祝圣§!我们境内的天体将使[Root.GetName]感到满意。
entries.en: §YConsecrating§! a celestial body within our borders will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 我们褫夺了一个祝圣星球的神圣性。[Root.GetName]不会轻易忘记此事。
entries.en: We stripped the sanctity from a consecrated world. The [Root.GetName] will not forget it soon.

entries.zh: 我们的一个祝圣星球被另一势力摧毁了。[Root.GetName]要求这种事绝不能再发生。
entries.en: One of our consecrated worlds was destroyed by another power. The [Root.GetName] demands that it never happen again.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]仍在为失去的祝圣星球而哀悼。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] still grieves for a lost consecrated world.

entries.zh: 让我们的人民保持清醒，使得他们随时都能够认识到他们肩上的责任与义务。任何我国人民均不处于化学极乐生活标准下将可以取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Keeping the populace aware and cognizant of their duties and responsibilities by subjecting none of them to the Chemical Bliss living standard will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 定居于行星殖民地，避开那些深空的居住站，这样能取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Restricting ourselves to planet-bound settlements and shunning Deep-Space Habitats will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 用完全义体植入体腐化我们的自然生物体会遭致[Root.GetName]的极度厌恶。
entries.en: Corrupting our natural bodies with full cybernetic implants will greatly displease the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 用有限合成植入物腐化我们的自然生物体会遭致[Root.GetName]的极度厌恶。
entries.en: Corrupting our natural bodies with limited cybernetic implants will displease the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 完全接纳义体植入体对我们自然身体进行强化改造会大幅取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Fully embracing the augmentation of natural bodies with cybernetic implants will greatly please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 采纳强调§Y纯净§!的传统可以取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Adopting any Traditions emphasizing §YPurity§! will please the [Root.GetName].
Adopting the §Y$ap_mind_over_matter$§! Ascension Perk will please the [Root.GetName].
Researching the £society£ §Y$tech_psionic_theory$§! Technology will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 从虚境中得到好处会取悦[Root.GetName]一段时间。
entries.en: Reaping beneficial rewards from the Shroud will please the [Root.GetName] for a time.

entries.zh: 从虚境中染上诅咒会使得[Root.GetName]不满一段时间。
entries.en: Reaping ill rewards from the Shroud will displease the [Root.GetName] for a time.

entries.zh: 于稀有文物中觅得宗教意义可取悦[Root.GetName]一段时间。
entries.en: Finding religious significance in Minor Artifacts will please the [Root.GetName] for a time.
Being a member of a $spiritualist_federation$ will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 成为某个$research_federation$的一员会使得[Root.GetName]不满。
entries.en: Being a member of a $research_federation$ will displease the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: [Root.GetCyberCreed]将会因为我们完全接纳他们的教义而被取悦。
entries.en: [Root.GetCyberCreed] are pleased by us fully embracing their teachings.

entries.zh: 拒绝并决绝并移除义体强化体、重获自己的生物遗产将会取悦[root.GetName]。
entries.en: Rejecting and removing cybernetic augments in order to reclaim our biological legacy will please the [root.GetName].

entries.zh: 维持至少§Y6§!个人口的机器人可以取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Maintaining a population of at least §Y6§! Robotic Pops will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 允许机器人和人工智能领域的研究和发展可以取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Allowing the development and study of Robotics and Artificial Intelligence will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 站在时代最前沿，不让其他任何国家的科技水平相较我们在§Y不分伯仲§!之上便可以取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Staying ahead of the curve and not allowing any fellow Empires to be more than §Yequivalent§! in tech level will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 与至少§Y3§!个帝国签订科研协议，加入一个研究合作组织，或给一个[root.owner.GetPreFTLLower]提供科技启蒙可以取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Signing Research Treaties with at least §Y3§! other Empires, being in a Research Cooperative, or providing technological enlightenment to a [root.owner.GetPreFTLLower] civilization will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 看到其它帝国炫耀他们的机器人人口，而本国境内的所有地区都没有同款型号，必定会惹恼[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Seeing other empires parade any kind of Robotic Pops around - with no domestic equivalents on any of our worlds - is sure to displease the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 采纳§Y探索传统§!可以取悦[Root.GetName]。
取得秘密知识——也就是某种古老的§Y洞见§!或者§Y数据缓存§!——会取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Access to secret knowledge - some kind of ancient §YInsight§! or §YData Cache§! - will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 研究稀有文物可取悦[Root.GetName]一段时间。
entries.en: Studying Minor Artifacts will please the [Root.GetName] for a time.

entries.zh: 揭示先驱者文明的上古秘辛会取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Unraveling the ancient mysteries of the precursors will please the [Root.GetName].
Being a member of a $research_federation$ will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 成为某个$spiritualist_federation$的一员会使得[Root.GetName]不满。
entries.en: Being a member of a $spiritualist_federation$ will displease the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 取回并进一步深挖我们的义体强化体潜能将会取悦[root.GetName]。
entries.en: Reclaiming and tapping further into the potential of our cybernetic augments will please the [root.GetName].

entries.zh: 取消对研究的不必要限制将令[Root.GetName]感到满意。
entries.en: Removing unnecessary restrictions on research will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 一个名义上经选举产生的政府可以取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: A nominally elected government will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 通过禁止强制迁移，取缔移民管制，确保民众的自由移民的权力来取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Ensuring the free movement of Pops by prohibiting forced Resettlement and disabling Migration Controls will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 禁止选择性人口控制，将会取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Banning the use of selective Population Controls will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 未能禁止奴隶制会惹恼[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Failing to ban the practice of Slavery will displease the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 让我们帝国的任何子民接受§Y阶层经济§!都将极大地惹恼[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Letting any denizen of our empire live in a §YStratified Economy§! will greatly displease the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 停止实行有利于精英统治阶级的政策可以取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Refraining from enacting Policies that favor the ruling elite will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 确保我国境内所有的物种，都能够平等地享有完整的公民权可以取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Ensuring that all species in our empire enjoy Full Citizenship status will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 我们的附属国向我们寻求指导和保护，而我们应当尽量尊重他们的自由来回报他们的信任。对附属国采纳宽宏性的方案将取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Our subjects look to us for guidance and protection, and we should strive to repay their trust by respecting their liberties. Adopting a benevolent approach to subjugation will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 成为某个$hegemony_federation$的一员会使得[Root.GetName]不满。
entries.en: Being a member of a $hegemony_federation$ will displease the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 建立§Y帝制或独裁制§!的独裁统治将会取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Autocratic rule - an §YImperial or Dicatorial authority§! - will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 生活在§Y民主政府§!的统治下将会极大地激怒[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Living under a §YDemocratic authority§! will greatly displease the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 实施阶层社会——无论阶层经济还是奴役，甚至净化——都将取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Ensuring a stratified society - be it through a stratified economy, slavery or even purging - will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 保持至少§Y12§!£pop£§H人口§!的奴隶可以取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Keeping at least §Y12§! £pop£ §HPops§! enslaved will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 实行保证上层精英特权的政策可以取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Policies that allow the enhancement of our Leaders will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 给每个星域分配一名§Y总督§!实施管理能够取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Keeping the Sectors in line by making sure each and every one is run by a §YGovernor§! will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 在[Root.Owner.GetAdj]境内任何有至少6个人口以上的星系维持至少§Y6§!支陆军可以取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Maintaining at least §Y6§! Armies of any type on all [Root.Owner.GetAdj] worlds inhabited by 6 or more Pops will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 采纳§Y支配传统§!将会取悦[Root.GetName]。
扩张我们的影响来对§Y附属国§!进行支配可以取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Extending our influence to dominate §Ysubject nations§! will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 成为某个§Y宗主国§!的附属国会使得[Root.GetName]不满。
entries.en: Being the subject of a foreign §YOverlord§! will displease the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 只有钢铁般的[Owner.Species.GetHandName]才能引领我们的诸附属国，从而避免他们变得懒惰和自满。授予他们过多的自由将会使[Root.GetName]不满。
entries.en: A firm [Owner.Species.GetHandName] is required to guide our subjects, lest they grow indolent and complacent. Granting them too many liberties will displease the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 就像[Owner.Species.GetSpawnNamePlural]一样，我们的附庸也需要引导来学习纪律。对他们严加看管将取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Like [Owner.Species.GetSpawnNamePlural], our subjects need guidance if they are to learn discipline. Keeping them on a short leash will please the [Root.GetName].
Being a member of a $hegemony_federation$ will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 放弃我们的精英军用强化体或屈服于集体意识国家将会使[root.GetName]不悦。
entries.en: Giving up our elite military augments or yielding to a collective mind-state will displease the [root.GetName].

entries.zh: 将我们的政策调整为§Y仅限防御战争§!可以取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Restricting our policies to §YDefensive Wars Only§! will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 要确保我们随时有至少§Y5000§!的£energy£储备，这样做能取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Keeping at least £energy£ §Y5000§! stored at all times will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 控制至少§Y1§!个战略资源可以取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Controlling at least §Y1§! Strategic Resources will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 控制至少§Y5§!个战略资源可以取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Controlling at least §Y5§! Strategic Resources will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 控制至少§Y10§!个战略资源可以取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Controlling at least §Y10§! Strategic Resources will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 采纳任何强调§Y繁荣§!的传统都可以取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Adopting any Traditions emphasizing §YProsperity§! will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 经济发展离不开稳定环境——不参与任何形式的战争可以取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Development requires stability - not engaging in warfare will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 在侵略战争中浪费资源与生命会极大惹恼[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Spending lives and resources on wars of aggression will greatly displease the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 将稀有文物应用于军事会使[Root.GetName]不悦一段时间。
entries.en: Expending Minor Artifacts for military applications will displease the [Root.GetName] for a time.

entries.zh: 将稀有文物用于民生会取悦[Root.GetName]一段时间。
entries.en: Expending Minor Artifacts for civil applications will please the [Root.GetName] for a time.

entries.zh: 成为某个$military_federation$的一员会使得[Root.GetName]不满。
entries.en: Being a member of a $military_federation$ will displease the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 让那些异见同情者的生活变得困难是种有效的威慑。
entries.en: Making life difficult for sympathizers can be an effective deterrent.

entries.zh: 让派系群龙无首的确是让他们消停的好办法，虽然效果不会长久。
entries.en: Rendering the Faction leaderless is sure to quiet it, for a time.

entries.zh: 在过去三个月内，没有发生针对派系领袖的暗杀行动。
entries.en: No assassination attempts made against Faction leaders in the past three months.

entries.zh: 赏赐那些忠于政权的人。
entries.en: Bestow favor upon those loyal to the regime.

entries.zh: 向§Y[Root.GetName]§!的所有人口添加§Y恩赐§!修正，稍微提升幸福度。
entries.en: Adds the §YFavored§! modifier to all Pops of the §Y[Root.GetName]§!, slightly increasing Happiness.

entries.zh: 我们每年只能施行一次奖赏，否则这项措施将失去作用。
entries.en: Our favor may only be bestowed once a year, lest it become an ineffective tool.

entries.zh: 蓄意降低民众对政权的支持度。
entries.en: Willfully lower popular support for the regime.

entries.zh: 向§Y[Root.GetName]§!的所有人口添加§Y暴政§!修正，大幅降低幸福度。\n
entries.en: Adds the §YTyrannized§! modifier to all Pops of the §Y[Root.GetName]§!, severely decreasing Happiness.\n

entries.zh: 我们只能每六个月施行一次暴政，否则这项措施将失去作用。
entries.en: We may only tyrannize our subject once every six months, lest it become an ineffective tool.

entries.zh: 派系的偏激言论越来越多，好战程度提升。
entries.en: A surge in radical rhetoric increases the faction's Militancy.

entries.zh: 该派系在一个殖民地筹划发动武装反叛。
entries.en: The faction stages an armed uprising on a colony.

entries.zh: 该派系在殖民地里发起暴动，破坏公共财产。
entries.en: The faction riots, ruining property on a colony.

entries.zh: 这个$FACTION$现在正奉献于$COUNTRY$的事业，没有问题需要考虑。
entries.en: The $FACTION$ are devoted to the $COUNTRY$ and have no Issues to consider.

entries.zh: 这个$FACTION$目前没有诉求需要考虑。
entries.en: The $FACTION$ have no Issues to consider at this time.
The $FACTION$ will never have any effects.
The $FACTION$ have no effects at this time.

entries.zh: 拥有一位与其思潮一致的统治者将取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Having a Ruler of their ethic pleases the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 拥有相反思潮的统治者将使[Root.GetName]不满。
entries.en: Having a Ruler of the opposing ethic displeases the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 统治者拥有与帝国一致思潮可以被[Root.GetName]容许。\n\n一位与其思潮一致的统治者将会更好。
entries.en: Having a Ruler matching the Empire's Ethics is tolerated by the [Root.GetName].\n\nA Ruler of their own Ethic would be even better.

entries.zh: 拥有一位与其思潮相符的统治者或内阁官员将会取悦[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Having a Ruler or Councilor of their ethic will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 在§H[parameter:planet.GetName]§!划分出一个星域作为其首都。
entries.en: Establish a new Sector with §H[parameter:planet.GetName]§! as its capital.

entries.zh: 释放§H[parameter:planet.GetName]§!使其成为新的独立帝国首都。
entries.en: Release §H[parameter:planet.GetName]§! as the capital of an independent Empire

entries.zh: 这个行星因缺乏人手而生产力下降。
entries.en: Planet output reduced due to a lack of manpower.

entries.zh: 此派系的每一个人口都会催生一个§R防御部队§!并试图夺取行星的控制权。
entries.en: Every member Pop spawns a §RDefense Army§! and attempts to take control of the planet.

entries.zh: 分裂主义者通过改变主动思潮或降低其他人口幸福度的方式来拉拢民心。
entries.en: The Separatists build Support, either by changing the Ethos or reducing the Happiness of other Pops.

entries.zh: 行星上所有属于此派系的人口
entries.en: All pops on planet in faction

entries.zh: 这颗行星没有发生地面战斗
准许在§Y[parameter:Planet.GetName]§!的殖民地作为一个附庸国独立。
entries.en: Grant the colony on §Y[parameter:Planet.GetName]§! independence as a Vassal Empire.

entries.zh: 行星上的暴乱§R毁坏§!了一座建筑。
entries.en: Riots on the planet §Rruin§! a Building.

entries.zh: 星域分裂主义者可能会出现在星域的各个星球里，意在让邻近的星球脱离帝国统治。如果有了足够的民众支持，他们就有可能发起武装革命。\n\n§H星域分裂主义者绝不会出现在我们的核心星域里。§!
entries.en: Sector Separatists may appear on worlds in sectors, seeking to free their stellar neighborhood from imperial rule. Given enough popular Support, they may even take up arms.\n\n§HSector Separatists will never appear in our core sector.§!

entries.zh: 星域分离主义者要求实现§Y[parameter:sector.GetName]星域§!的独立。
entries.en: The sector separatists want an independent §Y[parameter:sector.GetName] Sector§!.

entries.zh: 承认§Y[parameter:sector.GetName]星域§!的各个殖民地独立
entries.en: Grant independence to the colonies of the §Y[parameter:sector.GetName] Sector§!

entries.zh: 星域内无行星发生地面战斗
entries.en: No Sector Planet has ground combat

entries.zh: 回归派系的人们试图将自己从我们的国家中以独立国家身份被释放出去，这样他们就能自主重建他们所称颂的国家。如果国内其他的人群发现他们独立后的统治比我们的更诱人，甚至连其他人口也有可能会加入他们。
entries.en: Pops in Repatriation Factions seek to be released from our Empire as independent nations, so they can be re-integrated by the Empire they hail from. Other Pops may also join them, if they find foreign rule more enticing than ours.

entries.zh: 将所有属于这个派系的殖民地返还给§H[parameter:country.GetName]§!。
entries.en: Return all colonies with pops that belong to this faction to the §H[parameter:country.GetName]§!.

entries.zh: 该派系的成员§R摧毁§!了一座建筑。
entries.en: Members of this Faction §Rruin§! a Building.

entries.zh: 有该派系成员居住的所有殖民地生产力下降。
entries.en: Output reduced on all colonies with Pops that belong to this Faction.

entries.zh: 帮助民族主义者融入新社会，以减少其挫败感
entries.en: Reduce the frustrations of the nationalists by helping them integrate into their new society

entries.zh: 帮助民族主义者融入新社会，以减少其挫败感
entries.en: Reduce the frustrations of the nationalists by helping them integrate into their new society

entries.zh: 帮助民族主义者融入新社会，以减少其挫败感

entries.zh: 既有派系和新兴运动都对我们在§Y[root.GetName]§!建立的新殖民地产生了异常浓烈的兴趣。从我们宣布在这个适宜的[root.GetPlanetHabitat]定居的那一刻起，[root.owner.GetName]内的几乎所有政权都对此有话要说。\n\n我们的分析人士认为没有什么重大变故正在[root.GetName]酝酿，但还是建议小心谨慎。显然，我们的各种政治实体打算就着这个新兴世界大肆宣传。
entries.en: Established Factions and fledgling movements alike have taken an unusually keen interest in our new colony on §Y[root.GetName]§!. From the moment we announced settlement of this modest [root.GetPlanetHabitat], nearly every political voice in the [root.owner.GetName] has had something to say about it.\n\nOur analysts don't suspect that anything truly radical is taking root on [root.GetName], but they advise some caution. It's clear our various political entities intend to campaign vigorously on this burgeoning world.

entries.zh: 应当赞许这种热烈的议论！
entries.en: Such vigorous debate is to be commended!

entries.zh: 密切关注这些活动人士。
entries.en: Keep a close watch on these activists.
The risks are too great. Bolster security.

entries.zh: 我们不能容忍这种情况。
这片殖民地被各种政治派系视为开展运动的沃土。
entries.en: This colony is considered fertile ground for campaigns by Factions across the political spectrum.

entries.zh: 正在劝阻在这片殖民地上开展运动的政治派系。
entries.en: Political Factions are being discouraged from campaign work within this colony.

entries.zh: 坚决禁止政治派系在这片殖民地上开展运动。
entries.en: Political Factions are actively prevented from campaigning within this colony.

entries.zh: 按照指示，我们在[root.GetName]的线人一直在定期汇报殖民地政治局势的最新进展。简而言之：前景向好。\n\n地方执法者和政治代理人设法用最少的资源把公开异见控制在了最低限度。尤其是流氓派系，没能在殖民者那里占到一丁点好处。结果是我们仍然牢牢地控制着政治生态。
entries.en: As instructed, our informants on [root.GetName] have been delivering regular updates on the colony's developing political situation. In short: the trending outlook appears good.\n\nLocal enforcers and political agents have managed to keep outright dissent to a minimum, using only the bare minimum of resources. Rogue Factions in particular have struggled to gain any meaningful ground amongst the colonists; the result is a political environment which remains firmly within our control.
These patriots are to be commended.

entries.zh: 我们一直在收集有关[root.GetName]政治局势的数据，证实了我们的许多担忧。激进的边缘性运动已经成功地在殖民地的人口中获得支持。这些公民已经被社会公平和流动性的说教所动摇，并且不再认同我们社会的一些基本原则。\n\n尽管场面不太好看，但这仍然是个好消息。我们已经积累了大量的研究，对于完善我们的[owner.GetAdj]殖民政治理论非常宝贵。此外，我们诱导了这些边缘因素，让它们在首都站稳脚跟前就自己暴露了出来。
entries.en: The data we've been gathering about the political situation on [root.GetName] lends credence to many of our concerns. Fringe campaigns of a radical nature have managed to drum up support amongst the colony's population. These citizens have been swayed by sermons of social equity and mobility, and no longer subscribe to some of the founding principles of our society.\n\nDespite appearances though, this still amounts to good news. We've amassed a substantial body of research, invaluable for refining our theories about [owner.GetAdj] colonial politics. Moreover: by luring out such fringe elements, we have exposed these threats long before they could ever gain a foothold on the capital.

entries.zh: 或许……也许这种想法有一定可取之处？
entries.en: Or... perhaps there is some merit to this thinking?

entries.zh: 这个殖民地批准了更大胆的政论形式，换取了更好的监管，加深了社会学理解。
entries.en: This colony permits more disruptive forms of political discourse in exchange for better monitoring and sociological understanding.

entries.zh: 我们一直在收集有关[root.GetName]政治运动的信息，得出了一些有趣的展望。我们发现当地对新思想的包容度正在提升（超出了我们先前认定的稳定的政治思想），但没有离经叛道之举。\n\n尽管任何偏离我们核心思想的行为都可以说是削弱了我们的权力基础，但这仍然能算是个好消息。这次试验相当于一个实际的研究样本，对于我们完善殖民政治理论非常宝贵。此外，我们已经证明，即便给予边缘因素一定的政治土壤，[owner.GetAdj]的人民也会批驳他们当中最激进的成分，并相对地向我们国家的原则靠拢。
entries.en: The information we've been gathering about political campaigns on [root.GetName] has led to some interesting forecasts. We see a trend towards broader acceptance of new ideas - outside the bounds of what we would consider stable political thought - but no significant move towards radicalization.\n\nThough any deviation from our core message could be said to weaken our power base, this may still amount to good news. This experiment amounts to a substantial body of research, invaluable as we refine our theories about colonial politics. Moreover: we have proven that even when fringe elements are given some ground, the [owner.GetAdj] people refute their most radical elements, and stay relatively close to our nation's principles.

entries.zh: 那么，这种行为也许是值得鼓励的。
entries.en: Perhaps this conduct is to be encouraged, then.

entries.zh: 我们的政治学家一直抱着热烈的兴趣观测着[root.GetName]。然而，尽管近期掀起了激烈的竞选活动，媒体还对此大肆渲染，他们仍预计该殖民地的政治走向会是相当典型的结果。\n\n我们的研究人员注意到，这里“没有消息”就等于是好消息：尽管我们社会中的一些边缘分子发表了声明，但目前还没有迹象表明[root.GetName]正在被塑造成独裁的温床。目前，民主仍然是这里的一项基础性原则。
entries.en: Our political scientists have been observing [root.GetName] with keen interest. However, despite feverish campaigning and a lot of recent fuss in the media, they forecast a fairly typical outcome for the colony's political future.\n\nOur researchers note that 'no news' amounts to good news here: despite what some fringe elements in our society may claim, there are as yet no signs that [root.GetName] is being molded into a hotbed of autocracy. Democracy remains a founding principle there, for now.

entries.zh: 或许我们应该进行干涉。
entries.en: Perhaps we ought to shake things up.

entries.zh: 似乎我们社会之中的一些威权主义政治组织在[root.GetName]上生根发芽。他们的许多游说活动都把目标对准了这个蓬勃发展的殖民地；此外，尽管他们明显的成功尚未引起人们的警醒：我们的政治学家却认为需要对此抱持谨慎态度。对于[root.GetName]的[root.owner.GetAdj]而言，民主并非如同我们一开始想象的那样，是那么的重要或具有吸引力。
entries.en: It seems that some of the more authoritarian political bodies in our society have gained a foothold on [root.GetName]. Their campaigns were amongst many targeting this burgeoning colony, and although their apparent success isn't cause for alarm in itself: our political scientists believe some caution may be warranted. Democracy may not be as essential or as appealing to the [root.owner.GetAdj] of [root.GetName] as we first thought.

entries.zh: 对于我们的治国之道，这是颇有价值的检验！
entries.en: A worthy test for our way of governance!

entries.zh: 我们必须保护民主制度远离这类威胁。
entries.en: We must guard against threats to democracy.

entries.zh: 我们的政治学家对[root.GetName]进行了一段时间的监控，他们的报告证实当地存在着多种政治主张。\n\n目前还没有迹象表明[root.GetName]会陷入无政府状态，也没有类似模式的极端治理方式。然而，这种政治冷漠行为确实为[root.owner.GetAdj]的民主带来了一些独特的挑战——以及潜在风险，如果更极端的派系在此扎根的话。
entries.en: Our political scientists have been monitoring [root.GetName] for some time, and their reports confirm a wide range of political opinions have taken root there.\n\nThere are no signs yet that [root.GetName] will descend into anarchy, or other similarly extreme modes of governance. However, this much political jockeying does still present [root.owner.GetAdj] democracy with some unique challenges - and potential risks, if more extreme factions manage to gain a foothold there.
The §Y$planet_political_frontier$§! modifier will remain for approximately §Y9§! years, increasing $MOD_POP_ETHICS_SHIFT_SPEED$ by §G+50%§!.

entries.zh: 效忠派对[Root.Owner.GetName]的[Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle][Root.Owner.GetRulerName]忠心耿耿，没有任何诉求。
entries.en: The Loyalists are devoted to [Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle] [Root.Owner.GetRulerName] of the [Root.Owner.GetName], and have no demands.

entries.zh: [Root.Owner.GetName]的奴隶们通过自愿绝食，以毁掉自己身体的方式来对我们的生产进行蓄意破坏。[Root.GetName]派系的成员正在对[Root.Owner.GetName]内他们自己的人执行§Y净化§!。\n\n如果这一情况长期不得到重视，我们很有可能损失很大一部分的奴役人口。我们可以坐视这些可怜虫走向灭亡，也可以采用一些手段来处理这些不听话的派系。
entries.en: The slaves of the [Root.Owner.GetName] have organized to sabotage our means of production - their bodies - through willing starvation. The [Root.GetName] faction members are effectively §YPurging§! themselves from the [Root.Owner.GetName].\n\nIf this situation goes unchecked for long, we risk losing a significant portion of our enslaved pops. We can either let the wretches die, or find some other way of dealing with this rogue faction.

entries.zh: [slave_planet.GetName]的奴隶对其主人发动了起义，他们组织了一支反抗军来破坏[Root.Owner.GetName]对他们的合法统治！
entries.en: The slaves of [slave_planet.GetName] have risen up against their masters, forming an illegal rebel coalition intending to break the [Root.Owner.GetName]'s lawful hold on them!

entries.zh: 奴隶的身体不属于他们自己，他们无权将之损害或扣留。\n\n我们结束了这场净化，而那些还活着的奴隶则得到了适当的营养补充。
entries.en: The body of a slave is not theirs to damage or withhold.\n\nTheir careless purge is ended, and all affected who still live have been dosed with appropriate amounts of nutrients.

entries.zh: [unrest_planet.GetName]行星上的奴隶所进行的大规模抗议对行星的生产力造成了负面影响。
entries.en: Widespread unrest among the slaves on [unrest_planet.GetName]negatively affects their output.

entries.zh: 一股不满的情绪在[Root.Owner.GetName]的奴隶之间扩散开来，其中心是[unrest_planet.GetName]的[unrest_planet.GetPlanetMoon]。
entries.en: A queasiness spreads within the enslaved aspects of the [Root.Owner.GetName], centered on the [unrest_planet.GetPlanetMoon] of [unrest_planet.GetName].

entries.zh: §H[unrest_planet.GetName]§!的§H被奴役的人口§!，获得了§R奴隶骚动§!修正，持续§Y4年§!。
entries.en: §HEnslaved Pops§! on §H[unrest_planet.GetName]§! gain the §RSlave Unrest§! modifier for §Y4 years§!.

entries.zh: 一群暴徒——由擅离职守的奴隶组成——和[roving_gangs_planet.GetName]上的其他平民产生了激烈的冲突，并导致100口不幸逝世。\n\n死者的家属对这一事件的反应仍待观察。
entries.en: Roving mobs - comprised of derelict slaves - have gotten into violent confrontations with other members of the populace on [roving_gangs_planet.GetName], resulting in the untimely death of 100 Pops.\n\nIt remains to be seen how the associates of the deceased will react to this incident.

entries.zh: 显然，在我们的奴隶之中，几个激进的团体联合在了一起。他们的目的是将奴隶偷渡到[Root.Owner.GetAdj]领土之外。\n\n虽然尚且还不清楚这么大规模的犯罪到底是如何进行的，但可以确定的是，现在已经有奴隶逍遥于[Root.Owner.GetAdj]势力之外了。
entries.en: It appears that some of the more radical elements in our slave population have banded together to, essentially, remove slaves from [Root.Owner.GetAdj] territories.\n\nWe do not know how a crime on this scale was committed, but we are fairly certain that the slaves are now free, somewhere outside of [Root.Owner.GetAdj] space.

entries.zh: 看来，某个误入歧途的小派系十分热衷于通过将奴隶从自身的命运中解放出来并偷渡到[Root.Owner.GetAdj]边界之外让[Root.Owner.GetName]感到难堪。\n\n这些伤口对我们来说无足轻重，但我们希望那些迷途的羔羊能有一天知返，回到[Root.Owner.GetName]包容的怀抱和他们自身注定的命运之中。
entries.en: A misguided faction has seen fit to wound the [Root.Owner.GetName] by removing several slaves from their duties and smuggling them out of [Root.Owner.GetAdj] borders.\n\nWe will heal in time, and we hope that the lost eventually find their way back to the [Root.Owner.GetName] and their purpose in life.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]派系内的某些成员醉心于破坏[Root.Owner.GetName]的长治久安。他们希望通过破坏[riots_planet.GetName]上的生产设施来达到这一目的。我们只能猜想，无论他们造成了什么影响或损害，这一阻碍他们接受[Root.Owner.GetAdj]合法统治的愚蠢行为最后会让他们自取灭亡。
entries.en: Some elements in the [Root.GetName] faction have been gripped by a desire to hurt the [Root.Owner.GetName] by destroying a productive facility on [riots_planet.GetName]. We can only assume that whatever impairment it is that prevents them from accepting their place in the [Root.Owner.GetAdj] order also drives them to this roundabout form of self-harm.

entries.zh: 暴动的奴隶毁坏了[riots_planet.GetName]上的一栋建筑——要想恢复生产必须先修复建筑。
entries.en: Rioting slaves have ruined a building on [riots_planet.GetName] - it must be repaired before production can resume.

entries.zh: 奴隶群体中的激进分子——我们并非毫无预料——公然发动武装叛乱反抗我们合法的统治。\n\n据报道称，叛乱在[revolt_planet.GetName]上打响了第一枪，并有可能发展成燎原之势。
entries.en: The more radical elements among our slave populace have - not unexpectedly, some would say - taken up arms against our lawful rule.\n\nReports indicate that the unrest started on [revolt_planet.GetName], and may already have spread.

entries.zh: 为了[Root.Owner.GetName]的繁荣昌盛，一些人不得不从事比较卑微的工作。而这些人的不满已经酿成了一场灾难。\n\n他们利欲熏心，无法看到大局，竟然在[revolt_planet.GetPlanetMoon][revolt_planet.GetName]上发动了叛乱——而且似乎其它星球也想要跟随他们的步伐。
entries.en: Dissent among those assigned menial tasks for the glory and betterment of the [Root.Owner.GetName] has reached a catastrophic boiling point.\n\nTheir inability to grasp the bigger picture and their place within it has driven them to open rebellion on the [revolt_planet.GetPlanetMoon] [revolt_planet.GetName] - and other worlds may soon follow, if they have not already.

entries.zh: 在[Root.GetName]上的一所本地的小礼拜堂成员成功的煽动了几个[Root.Owner.GetAdj]奴隶，不满奴隶派的力量又增强了。
entries.en: Members of a local [Root.GetName] chapter appear to have successfully radicalized several [Root.Owner.GetAdj] slaves, strengthening the ranks of the malcontent slaves.

entries.zh: 行星分离主义者可能会出现在各个殖民星球里，意在让整个星球脱离帝国统治。如果得到足够的民众支持，他们就有可能发起武装革命。\n\n§H行星分离主义者只会出现在直辖的星球上。§!
entries.en: Planetary separatists may appear on colonized worlds and seek to free the planet from imperial rule. Given enough popular Support, they may even take up arms.\n\n§HPlanetary Separatists will only appear on directly-controlled planets.§!

entries.zh: [planet.GetName]上的动乱已经一触即发。当地的行星分离主义派系试图发起一场武装叛乱去夺取行星。
entries.en: The unrest on [planet.GetName] has reached critical mass. The local separatist faction has risen up in an armed attempt to take the planet.

entries.zh: §Y[planet.GetName]§!的内乱程度已经到达白热化阶段，一部分的§Y[Root.GetName]§!成员走上街头打砸抢烧。\n\n报告表明，有殖民地的主要设施被损毁。
entries.en: The civil unrest on §Y[planet.GetName]§! has reached a boiling point and members of the §Y[Root.GetName]§! have taken to the streets, looting and burning.\n\nReports indicate that a major colony facility has been ruined.

entries.zh: [Root.Leader.GetName]的突然死亡让[Root.GetName]陷入混乱。\n\n在[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]公众看来，这是[Root.GetName]内部政治斗争的结果。虽然派系内的一名新领袖已经逐渐崭露头角，但这一事件也令他们损失了不少的民众支持。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] is in disarray following the sudden death of their leader, [Root.Leader.GetName].\n\nAs far as the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] public is concerned, this is the outcome of an internal power struggle within the [Root.GetName]. While another figurehead has already emerged, the incident has resulted in a loss of popular support.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]在[parameter:planet.GetName]建立星域中心政府，并被承认为准自主星域。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] has been granted a quasi-independent sector, with local government based on [parameter:planet.GetName].

entries.zh: 为了平息分裂行动并有效肃清分离主义者，已允许[parameter:planet.GetName]的殖民地脱离[Root.Owner.GetName]的统治。\n\n随后[Root.GetName]成立了自己的国家。
entries.en: To appease and effectively eliminate the separatists, the colony on [parameter:planet.GetName] has been released from the [Root.Owner.GetName].\n\nThe [Root.GetName] have formed their own nation.

entries.zh: 他们将外国势力的首都标记为兴趣点，希望能将其攻占。
entries.en: they designate a PoI on a foreign power's capital and want it taken over.

entries.zh: 领导太空时代的十字军对抗[parameter:heathens.GetName]。
异教徒行星的污秽已被洗清！
他们的神庙已被污染，他们的神已不再眷顾他们。
entries.en: Their temples defaced, their gods have abandoned them.

entries.zh: 由于一个安保方面令人尴尬的失误，[Root.GetName]获得了我们外交沟通频道的基础通信权限。他们借机从自己信仰的角度，对[parameter:heathens.GetName]的各种异端信仰以及信仰产生的所谓道德沦丧进行了谴责和侮辱。\n\n由于[parameter:heathens.GetSpeciesNamePlural]高度宗教化，这一事件显得有些棘手。
entries.en: As a consequence of an embarrassing lapse in security, the [Root.GetName] gained brief access to our diplomatic communication channels. They used this opportunity to condemn and insult the [parameter:heathens.GetName] for various heresies committed and moral failings inherent in their beliefs.\n\nThe incident did not go over well with the deeply religious [parameter:heathens.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: §Y[parameter:enemy.GetName]§!对§Y我们的帝国§!新增了§Y派系羞辱§!评价修正。
entries.en: §Y[parameter:enemy.GetName]§! adds the §YFaction Insult§! opinion modifier towards §Your Empire§!.

entries.zh: 由于又一个安保方面令人尴尬的失误，[Root.GetName]获得了我们外交沟通频道的基础通信权限。他们再次趁机贬低了[parameter:heathens.GetName]的异端信仰。\n\n然而可以理解的是，[parameter:heathens.GetSpeciesNamePlural]并未被这次重复事件弄得措手不及，只是耸了耸肩无视了。
entries.en: As a consequence of yet another, intensely embarrassing lapse in security, the [Root.GetName] gained brief access to our diplomatic communication channels. They used this opportunity to once again belittle the heathen beliefs of the [parameter:heathens.GetName].\n\nHowever, the [parameter:heathens.GetSpeciesNamePlural] were understandably not taken off-guard by this repeated incident, and appear to have shrugged it off.

entries.zh: 情报表示[Root.GetName]的偏激分子正计划在[planet.GetName]发起武装反叛。\n\n这场反叛仍处于初始阶段，我们最好将它消灭在摇篮里。
entries.en: We have received reports that radical elements of the [Root.GetName] are staging an armed insurrection on [planet.GetName].\n\nTheir rebellion is still in its infancy, and it would be advisable to nip this in the bud.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]的激进分子们摧毁了[planet.GetPlanetMoon]上的一所建筑，位于[planet.GetName]。
entries.en: Radical members of the [Root.GetName] have ruined a building has on the [planet.GetPlanetMoon] of [planet.GetName].

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]的一小撮别有用心的异星暴徒已经毁坏了[planet.GetName]一栋建筑，这一行为无疑是对[Root.Owner.GetAdj]利益的蓄意破坏，其目的是为了扰乱我们的社会秩序。
entries.en: The xeno brutes of the [Root.GetName] have ruined a building on [planet.GetName] in a calculated attempt to hurt [Root.Owner.GetAdj] interests, with the apparent goal of destroying our way of life.

entries.zh: 看来[Root.GetName]的那些可爱的异见者们十分享受他们表达不满的方式——通过在[planet.GetName]上的蓄意破坏来给我们的政府找点外快来干。
entries.en: The otherwise lovely members of the [Root.GetName] have seen fit to express their dissatisfaction with our rule by disabling - some would say sabotaging - an installation on [planet.GetName].

entries.zh: 受支持者的鼓舞，[Root.GetName]决定以公然的武力夺回曾属于他们的领土。
entries.en: Emboldened by popular support, the [Root.GetName] has taken up arms in an effort to take back their territory by force.

entries.zh: 在[Root.GetName]发动叛乱的异种决定以暴力的手段推翻[Root.Owner.GetAdj]统治！
entries.en: The revolting xenos of the [Root.GetName] seek to overthrow [Root.Owner.GetAdj] rule in open rebellion!

entries.zh: 由于我们未能满足对方的要求，[Root.GetName]已经选择公开反叛。
entries.en: Recognizing our continued failure to accede to their demands, the [Root.GetName] has risen up in open revolt.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]的偏激分子潜入了至少一艘[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]军团舰船并埋下炸药。现在炸药已经引爆，导致[Root.GetName]严重受创。\n\n[From.Leader.GetName]，[From.GetName]的领袖，已发表声明宣称这是令人厌恶的暴力行为和暴徒本质的集中体现，尤其是[Root.Owner.GetName]和[From.parameter:enemy.GetName]的武装冲突。
entries.en: At some point, radical members of the [From.GetName] successfully infiltrated at least one [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] military vessel to plant explosives. These explosives have now been detonated, destroying the entirety of the [Root.GetName].\n\n[From.Leader.GetName], leader of the [From.GetName], has issued a statement declaring this action to be demonstrative of the abhorrent nature of violence in general, and the [Root.Owner.GetName]'s armed conflict with the [From.parameter:enemy.GetName] in particular.

entries.zh: 所有需要或导致对[From.parameter:enemy.GetName]持续冲突的外交行动已经被停止，我们已经提出了无条件和平。
entries.en: All diplomatic ties requiring continued conflict with [From.parameter:enemy.GetName] have been cut, and we have made an offer of white peace.
We hope they are happy with this.

entries.zh: 我们向[From.parameter:enemy.GetName]提出无条件和平，希望结束战争。
entries.en: We have made an offer of white peace to [From.parameter:enemy.GetName], hopefully ending the war.

entries.zh: 由于一个安保方面令人尴尬的失误，[Root.GetName]获得了我们外交沟通频道的基础通信权限。他们趁此机会严重侮辱了[parameter:enemy.GetName]并且要求他们立即归还[parameter:planet.GetName]。\n\n与[parameter:enemy.GetSpeciesNamePlural]沟通的过程不太顺利。
entries.en: As a consequence of an embarrassing lapse in security, the [Root.GetName] gained brief access to our diplomatic communication channels. They used this opportunity to gravely insult the [parameter:enemy.GetName] and demand the immediate return of [parameter:planet.GetName].\n\nIt did not go over well with the [parameter:enemy.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: §Y[parameter:enemy.GetName]§!对§Y我们的帝国§!新增了§Y派系羞辱§!评价修正。
entries.en: §Y[parameter:enemy.GetName]§! adds the §YFaction Insult§! opinion modifier towards §Your Empire§!.

entries.zh: 由于又一个安保方面令人尴尬的失误，[Root.GetName]又获得了我们外交沟通频道的基础通行信限。他们趁此机会再一次严重地侮辱了[parameter:enemy.GetName]并要求后者立即归还[parameter:planet.GetName]。\n\n然而可以理解的是，[parameter:enemy.GetSpeciesNamePlural]并未被这次重复事件弄得措手不及，只是耸了耸肩无视了。
entries.en: As a consequence of yet another, intensely embarrassing lapse in security, the [Root.GetName] gained brief access to our diplomatic communication channels. They used this opportunity to once again gravely insult the [parameter:enemy.GetName] and demand the immediate return of [parameter:planet.GetName].\n\nHowever, the [parameter:enemy.GetSpeciesNamePlural] were understandably not taken off-guard by this repeated incident, and appear to have shrugged it off.

entries.zh: 情报表示[Root.GetName]的偏激分子在[planet.GetName]建立了一支组织严密的叛军。\n\n这场反叛仍处于初始阶段，我们最好将它消灭在摇篮里。
entries.en: We have received reports that radical elements of the [Root.GetName] have formed highly-organized rebel militias on [planet.GetName].\n\nTheir rebellion is still in its infancy, and it would be advisable to nip this in the bud.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]的成员据说已在受到奴役的人群中煽起了异议。据谣传，他们正在训练甚至武装[parameter:slave_faction.GetName]的边缘分子，尽管这一点难以令人置信。
entries.en: Members of the [Root.GetName] are allegedly sowing dissent among the enslaved populace. According to some rumors, they are training and even arming fringe elements of the [parameter:slave_faction.GetName], though this seems far too outrageous to be true.

entries.zh: 尽管如此，还是让人担心。
有消息指出一些[Root.GetName]的更为激进的成员已经解放了一群[railroad_planet.GetName]上的奴隶，并将他们送到了[Root.Owner.GetName]的控制区之外。
entries.en: Word has reached up that some of the more radical members of the [Root.GetName] have freed a group of slaves on [railroad_planet.GetName] and spirited them out of the [Root.Owner.GetName]'s reach.

entries.zh: 我们必须密切监视他们。
entries.en: We need to watch them more closely.

entries.zh: 据说[Root.GetName]的偏激分子强制奴役了部分[Root.Owner.GetName]的非[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]人口。
entries.en: The rabid [Root.GetName] have allegedly forced some of the [Root.Owner.GetName] non-[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] populations into indentured servitude.

entries.zh: 据信，由于受够了[Root.Owner.GetName]对生活在身边的粗鄙外星人的软弱立场，[parameter:planet.GetName]上妄图成为奴隶主的一群人已经聚集到一起，结党成社，宣称独立。
entries.en: Supposedly fed up with the [Root.Owner.GetName]'s soft stance on the brutish aliens amongst us, the would-be slave owners of [parameter:planet.GetName] have come together, as a confederation of communities, to declare their independence.

entries.zh: [riot_planet.GetName]上受到净化的一群人铤而走险，攻击并摧毁了行星上的一处设施。
entries.en: Fueled by desperation, some individuals currently subject to purges on [riot_planet.GetName] have seen fit to attack and raze one of the facilities on the planet.

entries.zh: [death_planet.GetName]上那些因净化人口而陷入绝望的人向[Root.Owner.GetName]发起了武装反叛，并组建了一支涣散的叛军。
entries.en: Fueled by desperation, demographics currently subject to purges on [death_planet.GetName] have taken up arms against the [Root.Owner.GetName], forming a ramshackle rebel force.
